passive.name: The King Hears
passive.text: Each time your Noise counter fills, the King calls the vault for free and one more Hollow Warden rises.

notes: Noise matters here. Critical hits, explosions and area skills fill the counter; each time it fills a Hollow Warden rises, and the King calls another for free.
